sections.title: Vibefounding: Launching a Business with AI
sections.description: Vibefounding is an immersive, hands on course in which students create AI enabled startups. The opening sessions teach foundational prompt engineering and agentic workflows across multiple AI providers. By the fourth session, the focus shifts to entrepreneurial practice—idea generation, customer discovery, prototyping and business modelling—where AI is used to accelerate the traditional startup timeline.
